rationale: Y has a warmer, more distinctive cream, deep sea and kelp-green palette, an italic accent headline, richer per-feature illustrations and a cleaner mobile layout. X is competent with a good hero scene and floating UI cards, but it follows the dark-hero plus beige-card SaaS pattern and its feature illustrations are weaker. Y's hero data card partly covers the ROV and the page is a little more conventional in structure, but overall it is the more shippable and less template-like site.
